anti_trude_vector: Two-Arcade Oblique Parallax Aperture & Sibylline Rat-Swallow Coexistence Diptych: subterranean leaden rat-tunnels with batlike umbrellas and cheese-pack scrambles parting like crystal and transparent gauze into soaring swallows, dragonflies, and sunlit cornfields strictly at a 33.5 deg oblique two-arcade pause paired with an unforced pleasure gesture, snapping shut under any forced capture.
medium: Interactive 2D Canvas Oblique-Parallax Masonry & Crystal-Gauze Refraction Engine + Procedural Subterranean/Glass-Harmonica WebAudio
summary: Standalone interactive enactment of Marozia (Hidden Cities 3): the Sibyl's two coexisting cities (Rat and Swallow) mutate across three historical epochs while their relationship never changes—the second remains forever the one about to free itself from the first.
